test_title: PYST 57: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Miserably.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given options the correct option to fill in the blank is **Miserably.**
 
• **Miserably:** Exhibiting or expressing unhappiness
 
 
• **Example:** *They lost the game miserably.*
 
 

The complete sentence is: **On the way, several people suffered miserably and died too. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Excitedly:** In an exciting way.
 
• **Posthumously:** After a person's death.
 
• **Haphazardly:** In a way that lacks a clear structure or plan.
